PearlPBX2 API (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

REST API for PearlPBX2 — blacklist, whitelist, contacts, custom lists, call origination, and call recordings.

required

required
string (Caller ID) <= 64 characters

Caller ID to block

destination
string <= 64 characters
Default: ""

Destination number where calls must be blocked. Default= for whole system blocking.

reason
string <= 64 characters

Reason for blocking the caller ID

expiration_date

Expiration date for the blacklist entry. If not set, the entry is permanent.

calls

Originate several parties into a shared ConfBridge conference room

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
required
callerid
string <= 128 characters

Caller ID applied to the call, format 'name', e.g. '380443333333<0675653380>'.

timeout_ms
integer [ 1000 .. 120000 ]
Default: 30000

Max time to wait for the call to answer, in milliseconds.

parties
required
Array of strings >= 2 items [ items <= 256 characters ]

Channels to originate into the same conference room, e.g. ["PJSIP/101", "PJSIP/0504139380@mega-provider", "Local/2222@internal"].

room
string <= 64 characters

Conference room number. If omitted, a new one is generated and returned in the response.

context
string <= 128 characters

Dialplan context that lands each leg into ConfBridge. Defaults to settings.PEARLPBX_CONFERENCE_CONTEXT.

Responses

/api/v1/calls/conference/

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
{
  • "callerid": "string",
  • "timeout_ms": 30000,
  • "parties": [
    • "string",
    • "string"
    ],
  • "room": "string",
  • "context": "string"
}

Originate a call

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
required
callerid
string <= 128 characters

Caller ID applied to the call, format 'name', e.g. '380443333333<0675653380>'.

timeout_ms
integer [ 1000 .. 120000 ]
Default: 30000

Max time to wait for the call to answer, in milliseconds.

channel
required
string <= 256 characters

First leg to dial, e.g. 'Local/0503856087@default' or 'PJSIP/101'.

exten
required
string <= 128 characters

Extension/number the first leg is connected to, e.g. '0675653380'.

context
string <= 128 characters
Default: "default"

Dialplan context. Defaults to 'default'.

priority
integer >= 1
Default: 1

Dialplan priority.

object

Channel variables, e.g. {"userId": "0"}.

Responses

/api/v1/calls/originate/

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
{
  • "callerid": "string",
  • "timeout_ms": 30000,
  • "channel": "string",
  • "exten": "string",
  • "context": "default",
  • "priority": 1,
  • "variable": {
    • "property1": "string",
    • "property2": "string"
    }
}

config

Apply generated configs and reload Asterisk

Write configs (with backup) and reload Asterisk. Superuser only.

mode=soft -> module/AEL reload (keeps active calls). mode=hard -> 'core restart now' (drops every active call).

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
required
mode
required
string
Enum: "soft" "hard"

'soft': module/AEL reload, keeps active calls. 'hard': 'core restart now', drops every active call.

  • soft - soft
  • hard - hard

Responses

/api/v1/config/apply/

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
{
  • "mode": "soft"
}

Preview generated Asterisk config files (dry-run)

GET-only dry-run: same content as the admin's GET preview, no filesystem writes, no AMI. Superuser only.

Authorizations:
tokenAuth

Responses

/api/v1/config/preview/

dialplan-contexts

dialplan_contexts_list

Dialplan contexts (core.conf.make_dialplan_contexts()).

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

Saving here only updates the database; changes reach Asterisk after a superuser runs "Apply Changes" in the admin. The auto-generated "PEARLPBX-Users" context (rendered live from SIPUser data by core.conf.make_local_users_context()) cannot be renamed or deleted here, and extensions cannot be created inside it — see DialplanExtensionViewSet.

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
query Parameters
page
integer

A page number within the paginated result set.

Responses

/api/v1/dialplan-contexts/

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "count": 123,
  • "next": "http://api.example.org/accounts/?page=4",
  • "previous": "http://api.example.org/accounts/?page=2",
  • "results": [
    • {
      • "id": 0,
      • "name": "string",
      • "description": "string",
      • "extensions_count": 0,
      • "created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
      • "created_by": 0,
      • "modified_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
      • "modified_by": 0
      }
    ]
}

dialplan-extensions

dialplan_extensions_list

Dialplan extensions within a DialplanContext (core.conf.make_dialplan_contexts()).

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

dialplan must reference only macros that already exist — core.validators.validate_dialplan_field resolves the allowed macro set from the database at request time, so create a DialplanMacro before an extension that calls it with &name();.

tokenAuth
query Parameters
page
integer

A page number within the paginated result set.

dialplan_extensions_create

Dialplan extensions within a DialplanContext (core.conf.make_dialplan_contexts()).

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

dialplan must reference only macros that already exist — core.validators.validate_dialplan_field resolves the allowed macro set from the database at request time, so create a DialplanMacro before an extension that calls it with &name();.

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
required
context
required
integer
ext
string (Extension) <= 64 characters

Asterisk extension

dialplan
required
string (Extension scenario)

Use Asterisk AEL syntax to define the dialplan.

description
string (Extension description) <= 64 characters

Use latin symbols, digits and undercore to describe

queues_create

A call queue's static configuration (see the module docstring for how this differs from the AMI-backed views above).

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

name is looked up by Asterisk's app_queue from a literal Queue(<name>,...) AEL app-call embedded in dialplan text. Renaming or deleting a queue still referenced that way is rejected (400/409) rather than silently breaking call routing.

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
required
name
required
string (Queue Name) <= 64 characters
music_class
required
integer (Music on hold)
announce
string or null (Announcement to the member) <= 64 characters

An announcement may be specified which is played for the member as soon as they answer a call, typically to indicate to them which queue this call should be answered as, so that agents or members who are listening to more than one queue can differentiated how they should engage the customer

queue_announce
string or null (Queue announcement to the caller) <= 64 characters

An announcement may be specified which is played to the caller just before they are bridged with an agent.

strategy
required
string (StrategyEnum)
Enum: "ringall" "leastrecent" "fewestcalls" "random" "rrmemory" "rrordered" "linear" "wrandom"
  • ringall - Ring All
  • leastrecent - Least Recent
  • fewestcalls - Fewest Calls
  • random - Random
  • rrmemory - Round Robin Memory
  • rrordered - Round Robin Ordered
  • linear - Linear as configured
  • wrandom - Weighted Random
service_level
integer [ -2147483648 .. 2147483647 ]
context
string or null <= 64 characters

If a 'context' is specified, and a caller enters an extension that matches an extension within that context, they will be taken out of the queue and sent to that extension.

maxlen
integer (Maximum Queue Length) [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
timeout
integer [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
retry
integer [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
timeoutpriority
string (Timeout Priority)
Enum: "app" "conf"
  • app - Application
  • conf - Configuration
weight
integer (Queue Weight) [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
wrapuptime
integer (Wrap-Up Time) [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
autofill
boolean
autopause
string (AutopauseEnum)
Enum: "yes" "no" "all"
  • yes - Yes
  • no - No
  • all - All
autopausedelay
integer (Autopause Delay) [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
reportholdtime
boolean (Report Hold Time)
setinterfacevar
boolean (Set Interface Variable)
setqueueentryvar
boolean (Set Queue Entry Variable)
setqueuevar
boolean (Set Queue Variable)
announce_frequency
integer [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
min_announce_frequency
integer (Minimum Announce Frequency) [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
periodic_announce_frequency
integer [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
random_periodic_announce
boolean
relative_periodic_announce
boolean
announce_holdtime
string (Announce Hold Time)
Enum: "yes" "no" "once"

Should we include estimated hold time in position announcements?

  • yes - Yes
  • no - No
  • once - Once
announce_position
string (AnnouncePositionEnum)
Enum: "yes" "no" "more" "limit"
  • yes - Yes
  • no - No
  • more - More
  • limit - Limit
announce_to_first_user
boolean
announce_position_limit
integer [ 0 .. 100 ]
announce_round_seconds
integer [ 0 .. 2147483647 ]
Enum: 0 5 10 15 20 25 30
  • 0 - 0
  • 5 - 5
  • 10 - 10
  • 15 - 15
  • 20 - 20
  • 25 - 25
  • 30 - 30
announce_position_only_up
boolean

Only announce the caller's position if it has improved since the last announcement.

queue_announcement
required
integer
periodic_announce
string or null <= 255 characters

The list of files to announce separated by comma. Example: your-call-is-important-to-us, please-wait

(MonitorFormatEnum (string or null)) or (BlankEnum (any or null)) or (NullEnum (any or null))
joinempty
string (Join Empty) <= 100 characters

What to do when a caller joins a queue with no members in it?

leavewhenempty
string (Leave When Empty) <= 100 characters

When to leave empty queue?

ringinuse
boolean (Ring In Use)
timeoutrestart
boolean (Timeout Restart)
defaultrule
integer or null (Default Rule)

Escalation rule from queuerules.conf

Responses

/api/v1/queues/

routing-records

routing_records_list

Prefix-based routing rules within a RoutingTable.

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

Saving here only updates the database; changes reach Asterisk after a superuser runs "Apply Changes" in the admin. context and routing_table are required even though nullable in the DB — a null context would literally emit goto None,${EXTEN},1; into the generated dialplan, and a record with no routing_table never appears in any table's block.

sip_transports_create

PJSIP transports.

Every method requires a staff or superuser account — cert_file and priv_key_file carry TLS certificate/private key material in plaintext.

Saving here only updates the database; changes reach Asterisk after a superuser runs "Apply Changes" in the admin. Deleting a transport still in use by a SIPUser or SIPPeer returns 409 instead of failing at the database level.

Authorizations:
tokenAuth
Request Body schema:
name
string <= 32 characters

Example: transport-udp-nat

description
string <= 64 characters

Example: UDP + NAT for remote users

protocol
string (ProtocolEnum)
Enum: "udp" "tcp" "tls" "wss"
  • udp - UDP
  • tcp - TCP
  • tls - TLS
  • wss - WSS
bind
string <= 256 characters
local_nets
string or null <= 256 characters

Comma-separated CIDR networks, e.g. '10.0.0.0/16, 192.168.0.0/24'.

external_media_address
string or null (External RTP IP address)

This is the external IP address to use in RTP handling

external_signaling_address
string or null (External SIP IP address)

This is much like the external_media_address setting, but for SIP signaling instead of RTP media.

method
string (MethodEnum)
Enum: "default" "tlsv1" "tlsv1_1" "tlsv1_2" "sslv2" "sslv3" "sslv23"
  • default - The default as defined by PJSIP. This is currently TLSv1
  • tlsv1 - TLSv1
  • tlsv1_1 - TLSv1.1
  • tlsv1_2 - TLSv1.2
  • sslv2 - SSLv2
  • sslv3 - SSLv3
  • sslv23 - SSLv2.3
verify_server
boolean (Verify server certificate)

Require and verify the server TLS certificate (verify_server=yes)

allow_reload
boolean

Allow transport to be reloaded (allow_reload=yes)

cert_file
string
priv_key_file
string
ca_list_file
string

Responses

/api/v1/sip-transports/

trunk-groups

trunk_groups_list

Trunk groups (failover sets of SIPPeers).

Every method requires a staff or superuser account.

name is looked up by services/fastagi/fastagi.py via raw SQL from a literal dial-trunk-group,<name>, AGI call embedded in dialplan text. Renaming or deleting a group still referenced that way is rejected (400/409) rather than silently breaking call routing.

tokenAuth

page

string <= 64 characters
